ability.name: Celestium Burst Grenade
ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun
ability.effect: Pick 1 dice in that charge roll. Then, make a **bamboozling flak roll** of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the value on the dice, remove that dice from the charge roll.
